description: The runner's own control (`tools/runner-control.mjs`), played apart from the cases. `two-harnesses-for-one-class.json` is refused by point 2 (`host`) for one class two harnesses answer to, and here it is pinned to the namesakes `a-selector-two-namesakes-answer-to.json` names under the same point — the drift a pinned message exists to catch. The runner has to report it, and nothing of the case pinned to its own `message`. It has to report each variant besides, every one a rule no prepared case can prove, since every case is built to fire its own: without `harnesses`, `reexport`, a case that passed; with `check` set to `cards`, a case that fired another check.
